fixture_update_procedure: Refresh from an installed Wwise 2022.1.19.8584 SampleProject or an explicitly reviewed replacement source.
Copy only source-control-safe authored project files and intentionally selected original media.
Confirm git lfs track or .gitattributes covers *.wav before committing media changes.

hash_strategy.mode: path-plus-content over committed fixture payload files; excludes fixture-metadata.json and fixture-manifest.json bookkeeping files to avoid circular hashes

immutability.mutation_policy: Never pass this directory or any descendant as WWISE_SANDBOX_ROOT or WWISE_FIXTURE_PROJECT for destructive tests; copy it to a per-test sandbox before mutation.

provenance.copied_policy: All authored .wproj/.wwu project source files plus a tiny original-media subset required for deterministic unit fixture and LFS coverage. Generated outputs, caches, local settings, validation caches, logs, profiler captures, and bulk media are intentionally excluded.
provenance.type: curated copy from local Audiokinetic SampleProject

required_authored_objects.object: OutputBus Silence and Conversion PCM references
States/Default Work Unit plus Music/Dynamic Dialogue authored state work units
NYC Ambience RTPC curves and Game Parameters
WAAPI SoundEngine runtime-only scenario; no project-authored object required
Read-only project suitable for copied sandbox launch; profiler captures are excluded generated evidence
